user.title: Panoptes
user.description: How should your car talk to Home Assistant?

menu_options.internet: Over the internet (recommended) – works on mobile data too, 3 taps
menu_options.direkt: Direct – same Wi-Fi or Tailscale, live in both directions

direkt.title: Connect directly
direkt.description: Enter the Panoptes address (shown next to the “Connect to Home Assistant” button), e.g. `100.64.0.10` or `http://192.168.0.50:8180`. You then allow the connection with one tap in Telegram or in Panoptes – no code to type.

nur_lokal.title: Home Wi-Fi only
nur_lokal.description:
This Home Assistant has no address reachable from the internet (neither Home Assistant Cloud/Nabu Casa nor an own external URL). Your car can then only send data while it is on your Wi-Fi ({adresse}). Nothing arrives on the road.

For on the road: enable Home Assistant Cloud or set an external URL under Settings → System → Network. Continue anyway?

zeroconf_confirm.title: Panoptes found
zeroconf_confirm.description: “{name}” was found on your network ({url}). Connect now? Panoptes will then ask for your permission in Telegram or the Panoptes web UI.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect
reauth_confirm.description: The pairing with Panoptes ({url}) expired or was revoked. Connect again?

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: New address of the same car (e.g. Tailscale instead of Wi-Fi). The pairing is kept.

progress.auto:
**1.** [Send to my Panoptes bot]({link}) – in Telegram pick the chat with your Panoptes bot.

**2.** Panoptes asks you. Compare the check number: **{pruefzahl}**

**3.** Tap **Allow**. Done – this window closes by itself.

Without Telegram: paste this text in Panoptes → System → Home Assistant:

`{text}`

Valid until {bis}.
progress.freigabe:
Now tap **Allow** in **Telegram** or in **Panoptes → Paired devices**.

Check number: **{pruefzahl}**

Compare the number – it must match exactly. Device: “{geraet}”. The request is valid for 2 minutes.

error.nicht_erreichbar: Panoptes is not reachable. Same Wi-Fi or Tailscale? Is the car awake?
error.zu_viele_anfragen: Too many open requests. Please wait 2 minutes.
error.panoptes_zu_alt: This Panoptes version does not support the Home Assistant interface yet. Please update Panoptes.
error.anderes_auto: A different car (or no Panoptes) answers at this address.

abort.already_configured: This car is already set up.
abort.abgelehnt: The connection was declined in Panoptes.
abort.abgelaufen: The request expired (2 minutes). Please try again.
abort.schon_abgeholt: This approval was already used. Please try again.
abort.nicht_erreichbar: Panoptes was not reachable during approval.
abort.panoptes_zu_alt: This Panoptes version does not support the Home Assistant interface yet. Please update Panoptes.
abort.anderes_auto: A different car answers at this address.
abort.keine_adresse: Home Assistant does not know its own address. Please set it under Settings → System → Network.
abort.keine_kennung: Panoptes did not announce an id.

data_description.position: Only works if “Share position with Home Assistant” is also enabled in Panoptes.
data_description.einstellungen: Stored Panoptes settings only. Vehicle commands (climate, locks, lights, horn, windows) are deliberately not available. Access settings stay read-only.

einstellung_abgelehnt.message: Panoptes did not save the setting: {grund}

eintrag_nicht_geladen.message: Panoptes is not connected right now.

regel_nicht_ausloesbar.message: This rule contains a vehicle action and cannot be triggered from Home Assistant.

ruhezeit.name: Telegram quiet time
ruhezeit.description: Mute Panoptes Telegram messages for a while (0 = end).

regel_ausfuehren.name: Run rule
regel_ausfuehren.description: Run a Panoptes rule. Rules with a vehicle action are blocked.
